question: What conditions start a combat dive, a slide and a vault in SimEx_RootLayerLogic?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/root-part-1.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Combat dive (0x112c8, copy at 0x18c68): gate `CombatDiveAllowed_PerTeam`; speed > 4.0 x `AppliedSPMovementSpeedModifier`; `TimeSinceLastDiveOrSlide` > `CombatDive.CooldownDuration`; `CurrentAction` 0, or 1 within 0.134 s of `LastTimeOnGround`; then `RequestCombatDive = Sprint AND InputProne`. A 0.25 timer condition also applies.

Slide (0x15c04): gate `SlideAllowed_PerTeam`; speed > `Slide.AccumulatingThreshold.NeededVelocity` x `SoldierMovementSpeedMultiplier` x `AppliedSPMovementSpeedModifier`; a charge divided by `Slide.AccumulatingThreshold.NeededTime` must reach 1.0 unless a slide is already requested or buffered; `TimeSinceLastDiveOrSlide` > `Slide.CooldownDuration`; then `RequestSlide` is set.
Dive and slide share one timer, `TimeSinceLastDiveOrSlide`, capped at 10 and frozen during actions 13 and 25.

Vault: input direction thresholds +0.1 and -0.1; minimum obstacle height 0.31 (AI), 0.7 when speed exceeds 4.0, else 0.51; maximum from `Vault_StartHeightMax` or `Vault_StartHeightMaxDirectional`; after a jump the start height adds clamp(current height - `LastJumpHeight`, 0, 1).
`OptionSprintVaultOver`: vault-over is allowed when the option is off, or when sprinting.

inference: Actions 13 and 25 read as slide and dive from context.
Which input directions use the directional maximum height is inferred (the listing prints the same temporary on both arms of one select).
The 0.25 buffer is a time window only if the divided value is a frame time.
unresolved: The cooldown and threshold tunable values are named here but stored elsewhere.
The jump body and several geometry queries are undecoded operations.
Some branches test constant TRUE or FALSE, so parts of this code are dead; the findings file lists them.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Root soldier graph (code 0x10e2c to 0x20060) read: combat dive needs speed above 4.0 x the speed modifier and sprint plus prone input, slide needs a charge built above a speed threshold, both share a cooldown timer, and the vault minimum height is 0.31, 0.51 or 0.7
leads.summary: The second quarter of the root soldier graph was read. Combat dive: allowed per team, speed above 4.0 x the single-player speed modifier, time since the last dive or slide above a cooldown tunable, on the ground or within 0.134 s of leaving it, then sprint plus prone input. Slide: allowed per team, a charge that builds while speed is above a tunable threshold, the same shared cooldown timer (capped at 10), with a 0.25 buffer value. Vault minimum height is 0.31 for AI, 0.7 above speed 4.0 and 0.51 otherwise. 9 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: The dive and slide cooldown tunable values are joined to these rules, or an in-game timing is recorded.
leads.statusNote: Dive, slide and vault start rules read; constants raw-checked.
